subject.title: fix(copilot): keep tool transcript groups structurally complete

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose the shared atomic transcript-batch seam with the PR’s fail-closed behavior—dropping an incomplete assistant/tool group and marking replay invalid—rather than keeping this behavior Copilot-private?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive shared plugin-runtime contract affecting canonical persisted session state; tests can prove atomicity but cannot choose the long-term cross-harness policy.

options.title: Accept the shared atomic contract
options.body: Approve the reusable batch facade and its fail-closed group semantics, then require a current-main merge refresh before landing.

options.title: Keep the behavior Copilot-private
options.body: Pause this PR for a redesign that avoids publishing the new shared runtime seam and limits the policy to the Copilot extension.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared atomic contract
recommendation.body: Approve the reusable batch facade and its fail-closed group semantics, then require a current-main merge refresh before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: The available commit history ties this contributor most directly to the proposed Copilot journal and transcript-batch contract, though broader current-main ownership remains unverified.
